izzyondroid:de.eric_scheibler.tactileclo.name: Tactile Clock
izzyondroid:de.eric_scheibler.tactileclo.summary: Double click the power button of your device to vibrate the current time
izzyondroid:de.eric_scheibler.tactileclo.description:
This Android app vibrates the current time when the display is locked and you double-click the power button of your device.
 How it works
 Double-click the power button. This might take some practice to work reliably. Press slowly and deliberately. If you double-click too fast the system only recognizes a single click and turns the screen on instead.
 The time vibration is structured as follows:
 A short vibration stands for the digit 1 and a long one for the digit 5. The 2 is represented by two consecutive short vibrations, the 6 by a long and a short one and so on. The 0 constitutes an exception with two long vibrations.
 Examples:
 00:00 = -- --
 01:18 = . . -...
 02:51 = .. - .
 10:11 = . -- . .
 19:06 = . -.... -.
 Explanation:
 The time is processed digit by digit:
 . = short vibration
 - = long vibration
 Leading zeros in the hour and minute fields are omitted.
 Gaps:
 To simplify the recognition of the vibration pattern, there exist three kind of gaps with different durations:
 []: A short gap between vibrations in the same digit
 [  ]: A medium gap for the separation of two digits within the hour and minute field
 [    ]: A long gap to split hours and minutes
 Additional features
 Keep informed about the current time. The app can vibrate the current time automatically every X minutes or every hour.
 Play the Greenwich Time Signal at the start of each hour, similar to a radio station.
 Trigger time vibration with Tasker (see below for details)
 Decide what to do if you double-click when the display is on. You can choose between a warning vibration and having the time vibrated as well.
 The app starts automatically after the system reboots.
 Double-click conflict
 TactileClock is triggered by clicking the power button twice in quick succession. This may conflict with the 'built-in' double-click action of your Android device. For example, a Google Pixel device will typically launch the camera when the power button is double-clicked; a Samsung device may take a screenshot when the power button is double-clicked.
 If your device has a 'built-in' action when the power button is double-clicked, there are three options to get TactileClock working.
 Option 1: Disable the 'built-in' double-click action of your device.
 Google Pixel: (Settings > System > Gestures > Quickly open camera)
 Samsung Galaxy: (Settings > Advanced Features > Side Button > Double Press)
 Other devices may require different settings to disable the double-click action.
 Once the 'built-in' double-click action has been disabled, double-clicking the power button will trigger the TactileClock action.
 Option 2: Configure TactileClock to trigger after a long double-click.
 This will allow the 'built-in' double-click action to co-exist with the TactileClock double-click action.
 1. Open TactileClock 2. Swipe left to show the 'Shortcut' screen. 3. Modify the 'Click Interval:'. 3a. Set 'From:' to be 500ms. 3b. Set 'To:' to be 1500ms. 
 The From: and To: values specified above should work, but may need to be adjusted for optimal results on your device. Once configured, a fast double-click will trigger your devices 'built-in' action, while a slow double-click will trigger the TactileClock action.
 Option 3: Use Tasker to trigger time vibration with custom events

izzyondroid:helium314.localbackend.name: Local NLP Backend
izzyondroid:helium314.localbackend.summary: Location provider for UnifiedNlp and microG using only local data.
izzyondroid:helium314.localbackend.description:
The backend passively monitors the GPS and scans for nearby WiFis and mobile cells/towers. From this a database of emitter locations is created. When UnifiedNlp / microG request a location from Local NLP Backend , a scan for nearby emitter is initiated and a location determined based on the scan results.
 Local NLP Backend is a fork of the Déjà Vu NLP Backend with some improvements and a crude UI for configuration and importing / exporting data, including cell lists from MLS or OpenCelliD.
 This backend uses no network data. All data acquired by the phone stays on the phone, though it may be exported manually.
 How to use: 
 Local NLP Backend can be used like Déjà Vu: just enable the backend and let it build up the database by frequently having GPS enabled, e.g. using a map app. If you have a Déjà Vu database (you'll need root privileged to extract it), it can be imported in Local NLP Backend. Further import options are databases exported by Local NLP Backend, and cell csv files from MLS or OpenCelliD. Note that the local database needs to be filled, either using GPS or by importing data, before Local NLP Backend can provide locations!
 In order to speed up building the database, LocalNLP has an optional active mode that enabled GPS when there is no known emitter nearby (low setting) or when any unknown emitter is found (aggressive setting).
 Note that microG has stopped supporting UnifiedNlp backends with 0.2.28. If you still want to use this backend (or others), you need to use older microG versions. This can only be recommended if you use microG for location only . Personally I use 0.2.10 , as with later versions location backends stop providing locations after some time.

izzyondroid:moe.shizuku.privileged.api.name: Shizuku
izzyondroid:moe.shizuku.privileged.api.summary: using system APIs directly with adb/root privileges from normal apps
izzyondroid:moe.shizuku.privileged.api.description:
When developing apps that requires root, the most common method is to run some commands in the su shell. For example, there is app uses pm enable/disable command to enable/disable components. This method has very big disadvantages:
 Extremely slow (Multiple process creation)
 Needs to process texts (Super unreliable)
 The possibility is limited to available commands
 Even if adb has sufficient permissions, the app requires root privileges to run
 Shizuku uses a completely different way. The most important feature Shizuku provides is something like be a middle man to receive requests from the app, sent to the system server, and send back the results. To the app, it is almost identical to the use system APIs directly. But it's much faster as it hooks into the system directly.
 Several apps already use Shizuku . If you want to integrate it with yours, take a look at the Developer guide . For users, there's also a User guide .

fdroid:app.fayaz.otgmaster.name: OTG Master
fdroid:app.fayaz.otgmaster.summary: Mount VeraCrypt, LUKS, BitLocker and APFS USB drives on non-rooted Android
fdroid:app.fayaz.otgmaster.description:
OTG Master lets you mount VeraCrypt, LUKS and BitLocker-encrypted USB drives, and read Mac APFS drives, directly on your Android device — no root required.
Connect an encrypted volume via USB OTG, enter your password or use your fingerprint, and access your encrypted files through Android's built-in Files app. Unmount safely when done.
FEATURES
• Multiple Encryption Formats — mount VeraCrypt, LUKS1, LUKS2 and BitLocker volumes (BitLocker with its password or 48-digit recovery key)
• Broad File System Support — read and write files on FAT32, exFAT, NTFS and ext4 partitions
• Mac Drives — read APFS drives, unencrypted or encrypted with a password, case-sensitive or not
• Read-Only Mode — optionally mount partitions safely without risking accidental modifications
• ext4 Repair — a drive that wasn't unmounted cleanly opens read-only; one tap replays its journal, as Linux would, and makes it writable again
• Auto Mount — automatically unlocks known drives on connect using biometric authentication
• Hub Support — multiple USB drives connected via a hub are all prompted in a single biometric step
• VeraCrypt Hidden Volumes — open a hidden volume with its own password, and protect it from damage while writing to its outer volume
• Keyfile Support — use a keyfile in addition to or instead of a password
• Custom PIM — supports non-default PIM values for stronger key derivation
• Cipher Selection — AES, Serpent and Twofish, VeraCrypt's five cascades of them, and SHA-512 or Argon2id key derivation
• Encrypt a Drive — turn a USB partition into a new VeraCrypt volume, with any of those ciphers, a PIM and keyfiles, or a LUKS2 volume for Linux; FAT32, exFAT, ext4 or NTFS inside
• Format — erase a partition in place as FAT32, exFAT, ext4 or NTFS, keeping its encryption and password
• Backups — back up folders between the phone and a drive, as plain copies or incremental snapshots in the standard restic format that restic opens on a computer; browse a backup as a read-only drive; reminders when one is overdue
• Recover Deleted Files — find files deleted from FAT32 and exFAT drives and copy them to the phone; only deleted files are listed, and nothing is written to the drive
• Phones and Cameras — another phone or a camera connected over USB shows up as a drive (read-only)
• Tablet Layout — on a wide screen, mounted drives sit beside the unlock form
• Partitioned Disks — scans MBR/GPT partition tables and lets you pick the exact volume to unlock
• No Root Required — works on standard, unmodified Android devices
• No Cloud, No Tracking — your files never leave your device
REQUIREMENTS
• Android 8.0 (Oreo) or later
• USB OTG cable or adapter
• A VeraCrypt, LUKS or BitLocker-encrypted USB drive, or an APFS drive from a Mac
OTG Master is free and open source.

fdroid:com.iwadjp.pixeltagdrawer.description:
Pixel Tag Drawer is a companion app for Android. It lists the launchable apps
on your device and lets you organise and filter them with your own tags. It
does not act as a home launcher; you keep using it alongside your existing
launcher.
Features:
* App list: shows launchable apps as "all apps", a selected tag, or "no tag",
 in a list or grid view.
* Tags: assign multiple tags to one app; create, rename and delete tags, and
 add or remove a tag on many apps at once.
* AND filter: show only the apps that have all of the selected tags.
* Search: filter the list by app name or package name.
* Sorting: by name, by most recently launched, by launch count, or by a
 usage-based "recommended" order.
* Pinned shortcuts: add a home-screen shortcut that opens a specific tag
 filter or the "no tag" filter.
Usage access (optional):
* The "recently launched", "launch count" and "recommended" sort orders use
 Android's UsageStats and UsageEvents, aggregated on the device (last 30 days
 for the first two, last 7 days for "recommended").
* These orders require granting "usage access" to the app manually in Android
 settings. There is no runtime permission dialog for it.
* If usage access is not granted, name sorting, search, tag organisation and
 tag filtering still work, and the usage-based orders fall back to name order.
Privacy and network:
* Works locally on the device. The app does not request the INTERNET
 permission and has no code that sends data to an external server.
* No account, no cloud sync.
* No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or later. Developed and tested on a Pixel 10a;
behaviour on other devices or launchers is not verified.

fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.sepia.summary: Share images without oversharing. X-ray, redact, and prove the file is clean.
fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.sepia.description:
Photos and screenshots say more than you think: where you were, what phone
you own, sometimes a hidden copy of the uncropped shot or a video clip
appended by motion-photo mode.
Sepia is the step before you hit send:
* X-ray: see everything the file says about you, ranked by severity. GPS in
 plain words, the hidden thumbnail shown, trailing data called out.
* Redact: ink and pixelation burned into the pixels, plus crop. Where the device supports code
 detection, QR codes are found and offered for covering.
* Prove it: the export is re-encoded from scratch, then Sepia re-opens its
 own output and shows you what is (and is not) still inside.
Everything happens on your device. This app has no INTERNET permission: the
operating system will not let it open a connection, and you can check the
manifest instead of trusting a promise.
Runs on Android 9 and newer, with Android System WebView 108 or newer.
Android 9 has had no security fixes since January 2022, so on a phone that
old Sepia works, but the phone itself is easier to break into.
No accounts, no analytics, no dependencies. GPL licensed.

fdroid:org.sufficientlysecure.keychain.description:
OpenKeychain helps you communicate more privately and securely. It uses encryption to ensure that your messages can be read only by the people you send them to, others can send you messages that only you can read, and these messages can be digitally signed so the people getting them are sure who sent them. OpenKeychain is based on the well established OpenPGP standard making encryption compatible across your devices and systems. For a list of compatible software for Windows, Mac OS, and other operating systems consult http://openpgp.org/software/.
Modern encryption is based on digital “keys”. OpenKeychain stores and manages your keys, and those of the people you communicate with, on your Android smartphone. It also helps you find others’ keys online, and exchange keys. But its most frequent use is in using those keys to encrypt and decrypt messages.

• K-9 Mail
• Conversations
• and many more…

★ Independent Security Audit: The auditing company Cure53 performed an intensive security audit of OpenKeychain. The security experts summarize their final result with "[...] none of the spotted issues were considered to be of a critical severity in terms of security implications. The latter is a significant and impressive result for an app of this complexity and relevance."
★ Permissions: Because OpenKeychain is Free Software, anyone can validate that the permissions are indeed only required for the listed features.
• In-app purchases: Donate to the developers
• Identity: Pre-fill name and email addresses
• Contacts: Connect keys to your contacts (only offline)

fdroid:space.subread.app.summary: Line an audiobook up with its ebook: subtitles and video, made on your device.
fdroid:space.subread.app.description:
SubRead lines an audiobook up with its ebook, sentence by sentence, and gives you subtitles with the time of each line. Read along while you listen: for language learners, and for anyone who wants text and voice together.
The words come from your book, not from a speech model. A small model only listens for where the narrator is; the text of each line is the book's own. Names, spelling and punctuation stay right.
WHAT IT MAKES
• Subtitles (.srt) - each line of the book with the time it is read. Made for Hoshi Reader's read-along, and they work in any player.
• Video + subtitles - an .mp4 of the book's cover over the audio, with the .srt beside it. It plays with subtitles in any video player, and you can upload it to YouTube. 720p and larger, 1 to 60 frames a second. The picture is still, so the video adds only about 60 MB to a 10-hour book.
WHAT IT TAKES
• Audio: m4b, m4a, mp3, opus, ogg, flac, wav
• Book: epub, plain text, Aozora Bunko zip
• Languages: Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Finnish, English, German, French, Italian, Chinese, Korean and more, or automatic detection
PRIVATE, AND YOURS
• All of the work is done on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
• No account, no ads, no tracking. The app asks for no permissions and does not use the network.
• Free, and open source (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/equwal/subread-android
GOOD TO KNOW
• A long book takes hours: about a third of the length of the audio on a mid-range device. Keep the app open while it works. If it is interrupted, Continue starts from where it was.
• Pages that nobody reads aloud (front matter, notes) are left out by themselves.
• The app needs a 64-bit ARM processor from about 2018 or later (ARMv8.2).
• You need the audiobook and the ebook of the same text. A different edition or translation gives poor results; the app tells you how much of the book it found.
In a hurry, or on an old phone? The same conversion runs in a browser at https://subread.space

firefox-addons:2633110.name: ductivityPRO: Become a Productivity Pro
firefox-addons:2633110.summary: A productivity extension for Firefox that helps you regulate yourself by taking control of the time you spend on the internet.
firefox-addons:2633110.description:
Allows you to set a timer for the amount of time you want to spend on a tab. Once that's over, the extension warps the page(tilting the web page and giving it a border) and sends you a notification. In order to enable the full functionality of the extension and customize it, click on the settings icon on the top right hand corner of the popup or the preferences tab in about:addons.
Features:
1. There are no preset times, you can set any time between 0 to 60 minutes.
2. If you're in full screen mode on YouTube or elsewhere it will automatically bring you out of it.
3. The amount of tilt of the webpage is fully customizable and can be changed from the preferences settings.
4. The width of the border is also fully customizable and can be changed from the preferences settings.
5. Even if you move between different websites in a tab the alarm will still ring and the page will still be warped.
6. You can see the amount of time left in your timer in the toolbar popup. 
7. If something changes and you need to spend more time on the page, clicking the "u" in the d(u)ctivityPRO popup will undo the warp.
8. You can clear alarms after they are set from the popup.
9. If you want to use it for work or simply for pomodoros you can set the tilt to 0 and the border to 0.
10. The extension can disable the polymer version of YouTube for videos. This is because with the new polymer version of youtube you can't go into full screen mode once the alarm rings. So if you're using this to curb your binge watching tendencies you can just leave polymer mode on. Otherwise you can disable it in the options menu. It doesn’t disable it for the main menu because it’s easier to navigate with the new polymer design and looks much better, it only disables polymer for the actual page with the video.
This extension does not store or collect any information about you. The tilt and border you set are stored locally. No information of any kind is transmitted to us.

firefox-addons:2884828.name: Copy Video Frame
firefox-addons:2884828.summary: Capture the current picture of a video as an image. Copy it to the clipboard or look at it in a small window, from a right click, a keyboard shortcut or the toolbar button.
firefox-addons:2884828.description:
Capture the current picture of a video as an image. Copy it to the clipboard or look at it in a small window, from a right click, a keyboard shortcut or the toolbar button.
 Quick start 
 Hold Shift and right click a video. Holding Shift gets you the normal Firefox menu even on pages that show their own menu for the video.
 Choose "Copy Video Frame".
 The picture is captured, a short white flash and a shutter sound confirm it, and the image is ready:
 if you have allowed clipboard access, it is copied to the clipboard as an image, ready to paste
 otherwise it opens in a small window. Right click the image there to copy or save it.
 Three ways to capture 
 Right click menu : Shift and right click the video, then "Copy Video Frame". This works for videos in embedded frames too.
 Keyboard shortcut : press Alt+Shift+V to capture the video under the mouse. If the mouse is not over a video, the first video on the page is used. You can change the keys in the Add-ons Manager (Manage Extension Shortcuts).
 Toolbar button : click it to capture the first video that is visible in the tab. This is handy when you would rather not hover over the video.
The shortcut and the toolbar button only find videos in the page itself, not in embedded frames. Use the right click menu for videos inside frames.
If no video is found, a small window explains what went wrong.
 Where the image goes 
 Clipboard : needs the optional permission to put data into the clipboard. Allow it in the Add-ons Manager on the Permissions tab of this add-on. After that, every capture is copied as an image right away.
 Window : without the permission, the image opens in a small window that fits the video, up to 90 percent of your screen. The picture scales down to fit.
 How the picture is taken 
 Directly from the video : the default. The current frame is read from the video in its original size, so it is sharp. It works even if the video is scrolled out of view. Anything drawn on top of the video, such as subtitles or buttons of a custom player, is not part of the picture.
 Screenshot of the video : used automatically for protected (DRM) videos and other videos that do not allow reading their frames. The visible area of the video is captured from the screen, cropped to the video. Everything visible on top of it, including subtitles, is part of the picture. The video has to be on screen for this.
The controls of the video are hidden for a moment during the capture, so that they do not end up in the picture, and are brought back right after.
 Options 
The options page opens once after the installation and later from the add-on preferences. It has a "How to use" section and these settings, which are saved right away:
 Shutter sound : switch the sound on or off, test it, upload your own sound (MP3, WAV or OGG, up to 500 KB) or go back to the built-in sound.
 Always use screenshot capture : always use the screenshot method, even for ordinary videos. Use it to get subtitles and other overlays in your pictures. The video must be on screen.
 Permissions and privacy 
 menus: add "Copy Video Frame" to the right click menu of videos.
 activeTab: read the video in the tab you use the add-on on, and take the screenshot of the tab.
 storage: remember the sound and capture settings.
 clipboardWrite (optional): copy the image to the clipboard.
The add-on does not collect or transmit any data. The pictures stay on your computer.

 This add-on is completely safe to use.

firefox-addons:2943715.name: Downloader for Reddit - RedditGrab
firefox-addons:2943715.summary: Grab images and videos from Reddit posts (Redgifs included). Supports individual downloads and automated mass downloading.
firefox-addons:2943715.description:
Features
 Individual post downloads via injected buttons
 Mass downloads with auto-scrolling
 Customizable download settings and folder organization
 Title overlay on images and videos
 Image and video processing
 No analytics or data collection
Step 1: Basic Usage
 Go to Reddit : Navigate to any Reddit page ( reddit.com )
 Individual Downloads : Look for blue "Download" buttons on posts and click them
 Mass Downloads : Click the RedditGrab extension icon to open the sidebar panel
Step 2: Configure Settings (Optional)
 Download Folder : Set where files are saved (default: Downloads/Reddit Downloads)
 Filename Pattern : Customize file names (supports {subreddit}, {timestamp}, {filename})
 Title Overlay : Enable to add post titles to images/videos
Step 3: Start Downloading
 Single Post : Click any blue "Download" button
 All Posts : Open sidebar → Click "Start Mass Download" → Extension auto-scrolls and downloads everything

firefox-addons:2828898.name: KPN Password Manager
firefox-addons:2828898.summary: KPN Password Manager is een wachtwoordmanager die jou helpt om veilig, snel en gemakkelijk overal in te loggen.
firefox-addons:2828898.description:
Bescherm jouw bedrijf 
Bespaar tijd, werk veiliger en maak inloggen gemakkelijk. Met de KPN Password Manager genereer, beheer, en auto-fill je veilig jouw wachtwoorden overal en op elk device. Stel jouw bedrijf in staat om een sterk wachtwoordbeleid te hanteren, risico’s te beperken en jouw bedrijfscontinuïteit beter te beschermen. 
 Moeiteloos in gebruik 
Gebruikers beschermen en gebruiken moeiteloos zakelijke inloggegevens en overige gevoelige informatie. Wachtwoorden hoeven niet meer zelf bedacht, onthouden of opgezocht te worden. Je medewerkers besparen tijd door het gebruik van de KPN Password Manager en worden productiever. Ze zijn geen tijd meer kwijt aan het beheer of herstel van inloggegevens. Bestaande wachtwoorden kunnen ook zonder moeite geïmporteerd worden zodat je alles veilig op 1 plek hebt. Krijg naadloos en veilig toegang tot de eigen inloggegevens door het gebruik van Single Sign-On (SSO) en Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). De KPN Password Manager doet het werk, met jouw privacy en veiligheid als hoogste prioriteit. 
 Data privacy & veiligheid 
Alle data wordt veilig, met end-to-end encryption, gesynchroniseerd naar de cloud van een Nederlands datacenter. Jouw privacy en de veiligheid van jouw data staan centraal. Alleen jij als gebruiker hebt overal veilig toegang tot jouw actuele versleutelde gegevens. Op elke locatie, via elke browser, of elk apparaat. Deze gegevens blijven verder voor iedereen geheim, dus ook voor ons. Alle gegevens worden versleuteld met AES-GCM en RSA-2048 keys.
 Nederlandse KPN dienst 
De KPN Password Manager is een Nederlandse dienst die is ontwikkeld door KPN in samenwerking met een partner die gespecialiseerd is in encryptie en security.
 Met de KPN Password Manager krijg je: 
• Moeiteloos inloggen: altijd in 1x snel en makkelijk overal inloggen met een druk op de knop.
• Overal toegang: op elke locatie, via elke browser, of elk apparaat – Windows, Mac, iOS, Android.
• Gecentraliseerde veilige opslag: bewaar en beheer al jouw inloggegevens & overige gevoelige informatie veilig op 1 plek
• Synchronisatie tussen je apparaten: altijd de meest actuele gegevens, op al je verbonden apparaten 
• Naadloze integratie met SSO: naadloos toegang tot eigen gegevens via de SSO integratie met KPN Grip
• Privacy: niemand, behalve jijzelf, heeft toegang tot jouw gegevens. Wij kunnen jouw gegevens ook nooit inzien, gebruiken, delen, of verkopen
• Dataopslag in Nederland: alle data wordt enkel in Nederland opgeslagen, onder de strenge Nederlandse en EU privacy- en datawetgeving
• Veilig informatie delen: houd controle over het makkelijk en versleuteld delen van gevoelige gegevens met collega’s 
• Gecentraliseerd gebruikersbeheer: via KPN Grip is gebruikersbeheer extra simpel en overzichtelijk
• Check op potentiële risico’s: check al jouw inloggegevens direct op risico’s en gelekte wachtwoorden 
• Compliance standaarden: de dienst voldoet aan de GDPR, SOC2, eIDAS-Regulation [(EU)910/2014], … standaarden en regulatie 
• Versleuteling van gegevens op basis van AES-GCM en RSA-2048 keys
Web omgeving: https://passwordmanager.kpn.com

Powerful Yandex AI on your phone helps with everyday chores and tackles tasks for study, work, and creativity.

- Alice AI LLM — a language model for answering questions and generating text;
- Alice AI ART — an image model for creating visuals;
- Alice AI VLM — a multimodal vision-language model for analyzing images, answering questions, and solving image-related tasks.
Ask questions, write and edit text—the Alice AI neural network responds accurately and comprehensively, and can enrich answers with images and source links. Speak by voice or type in chat.

apple-macos:972696951.description:
Origami Art Studio is a calm, beautifully simple companion for learning the ancient craft of paper folding. Browse a growing catalog of 30+ models — from a classic paper crane, heart, and boat to more ambitious stars, dragons, and dragonflies — and follow a clear, photographed guide through every single fold. A progress bar and a clear "Step X of Y" label always tell you how far along you are, so it is easy to pause, set the device down to make a fold, and pick up right where you left off.
Moving through a guide feels natural. Swipe left or right to go forward and back, tap the on-screen arrows, or use the keyboard arrow keys on iPad and Mac. When you reach the final step a friendly "Done" button brings you home to choose your next project. The home screen is a tidy, paginated catalog with thumbnail previews and a step count on every card, so you always know how involved a model will be before you begin.
Origami Art Studio is built to feel good on any device. The washi-paper interface — soft cream tones, warm ink lettering, and a single terracotta accent — was designed to be quiet and relaxing rather than loud and gamified. The responsive layout automatically shows one, two, three, or four columns depending on your screen, filling iPhone and iPad edge to edge without awkward borders. Gentle tap sounds give the pages a paper-like feel, and a single tap on the sound icon mutes them whenever you want silence.
The whole app speaks your language. A built-in language menu offers eight fully translated interfaces — English, Vietnamese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Hindi, and French — so menus, buttons, and labels always feel like home. Switching is instant and remembered for next time.
Whether you are folding with a child on a rainy afternoon, calming your mind after a long day, or picking up a mindful new hobby, Origami Art Studio keeps everything you need in one uncluttered place. Start with a simple crane today, then work your way up to a many-step dragon when you are ready. Grab a square of paper and begin folding.
Origami Art Studio never asks you to rush. There are no lives to lose, no daily streaks to maintain, and no ad ever interrupts a delicate fold mid-crease — an occasional short ad appears only when you open a new guide. Sit with one photograph as long as you need, then glide to the next when your hands are ready. The catalog grows with classic and creative shapes, so there is always a new project waiting — whether you have five minutes for a heart or a quiet evening for a many-step dragon.

Fold slowly. Fold carefully. Fold for the joy of watching flat paper become something alive.
